Name: AT x CP - Molamole's Wallpaper and Flooring textures
Author: MolaMole
Description:
[center][b]| Screenshots feature |[/b][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337]CP x AT - Molamole's Furniture Retexture[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116]AT x CP - Molamole's Artisan and Refining Craftables Retextures[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35163]CP x CC - Molamole's Countertops And Cabinets[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/center]

Here some Vanilla[b] Wallpaper & Flooring[/b] textures! to match the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27617][CP] Molamole's Farm Kitchen[/url][/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116][[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116]AT x CP] Molamole's Artisan and Refining Craftables Retextures[/url]'s woods.
[i](I wanted to add a chess tiles Wallpaper to my farm, then add other, and another, and ...)[/i]
Mostly Tiles, Wood and Stone textures.

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][AT]+[CP] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring Textures (+999)[/b][/*]
[*][b][AT]+[CP] [b]Molamole's Wood Frame Wallpaper (+999): [/b][/b]Wallpaper extension with wood frame[/*]
[/list]

[b][s][size=3][ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None for now (If you find one pls let me know!)
-
If you don't want the [i]Night version[/i] -The crystal/windows wallpaper getting dark at night or rainy days- you can delete the file "[b][CP] Molamole's
Wallpaper - Night[/b]", for the main ver., same with Wood frame wallpapers
[center]
[size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b][/size][size=4][b]
You need to have the [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿] / Mod -for the [AT] ver.-
[size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] and [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]] / [/b][/size]Mods -for the [CP] ver.-
to choose the texture[/b][/size].[/center]
[center][size=2][b]-
[size=2][b][size=2][b]Mole only upload Mods on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/][/url][size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size],
If you find them in other places, were submit without my knowledge
and I can't guarantee the safety of the file. 
Be careful there![/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][/center]


[center][i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------[/i][/center]

Aquí algunas texturas para [b]Pared y Suelos[/b]~! para ir a juego con el mod [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27617]Molamole's Farm Kitchen[/url][/b] y las texturas de madera del mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116][[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24116]AT x CP] Molamole's Artisan and Refining Craftables Retextures[/url].
[i](Inicialmente quería añadir azulejos de cuadros a mi granja, luego dibuje otro, que siguió a otro, que...)[/i]
Mayoritariamente azulejos, texturas de madera y piedra. 

Se dividen en dos archivos:
[list]
[*][b][AT]+[CP] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring Textures (+999)[/b][/*]
[*][b][AT]+[CP] [b]Molamole's Wood Frame Wallpaper (+999): [/b][/b]Extensión con marcos de madera[/*]
[/list]

[b][s][size=3][ Problemas conocidos ][/size][/s][/b]
Ninguno encontrado (deja un comentario si encuentras alguno!)
- 
Si no te gusta el [i]efecto de oscuridad[/i] en los wallpapers de cristal/ventanas, puedes eliminar la carpeta "[b][CP] Molamole's Wallpaper - Night[/b]" de la versión principal y la versión de extensión con marcos de madera.


[center][size=4][b]IMPORTANTE:
Es necesario tener el Mod [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿] / [/b][/size]para la versión [AT]
[size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] & [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]] /[/b][/size] para la versión [CP]
para seleccionar las texturas.[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][size=3][b][b]-
[size=2][size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2]La Topa solo sube Mods en la página de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿!
Si los encuentras en otra página, fueron re-subidos sin mi conocimiento
y no puedo asegurar la integridad del archivo.
Tengan cuidado por allí![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/center]
